input.free_text_description: This system is a task management platform that serves Developer, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for custmize exception handler, problem, problem. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Developer, I want to interact with rest aspect functionality, so that I can accomplish my rest aspect-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to interact with problem functionality, so that I can accomplish my problem-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to interact with project functionality, so that I can accomplish my project-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to interact with sub problem functionality, so that I can accomplish my sub problem-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to use custmize exception handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
